title: eo doctor --json — health check report
description: Emitted by `eo doctor --json` (src/eosdk/cli/commands/doctor.py) as a JSON ARRAY of sections, in the order src/eosdk/doctor.py::run_doctor produces them (Config, Discovery, Auth, Services). The exit code is 1 when ANY result has `ok: false`, and 0 otherwise — a skipped check (`ok: null`) is not a failure, which is what lets `eo doctor` be used as a pipeline gate on a machine with no session (SPEC §6.8). Section and check names are human-facing labels and deliberately not enumerated here: new checks must not break a consumer. Hand-written on purpose: it is a contract, not a projection. `additionalProperties` is true throughout.

ok.description: true = passed, false = failed (drives the exit code), null = skipped because the subsystem is not configured or needs a session. A consumer that treats null as failure will report false alarms on anonymous machines.

detail.description: What was observed, always present — the resolved value and its source for config checks, the error message for failures.

hint.description: The remediation for a failed check; null when there is nothing actionable to add or the check did not fail.
